conditional_arms.A4: Register after A0-A3 evidence: four recurrent sequences per minibatch and choice-KL guard 0.03; preserve the otherwise selected parent arm.
conditional_arms.A5: Register after entropy decomposition: coefficient 0.01 with the otherwise selected parent arm.

early_stop.probes: eight training-map reset states, read-only and RNG-preserving
early_stop.stopped_seed_disposition: failure retained in arm results; no replacement or selection of an earlier checkpoint

controls.uniform_greedy_rule: argmax of equal legal probabilities; smallest legal candidate row wins ties
controls.scripted_mode_rule: fixed public proposal in both modes; repeated seed cases do not create independent policy evidence
controls.reuse_rule: Exact hashes of control source, guide source, engine, content/settings/reset contract; identical split, map, mode, action seed and budget; completed native trace independently verified.

advancement.uncertainty: Fixed-seed nested bootstrap (training seed, map, paired action seed), retain historical t intervals; three training seeds are imprecise.

selection.rule: first eligible arm in preregistered order
selection.rationale: Prefer the earliest sufficient recipe without selecting the largest noisy observed effect. Execute all mandatory arms even if an earlier arm qualifies.
selection.if_none_qualifies: No held-out access; report failed advancement and follow the registered recovery decision tree.

held_out.mode_matrix: same one greedy plus three sampled action seeds per map and model/control as development
held_out.models: All three final trained models of the selected eligible arm; freeze model, binary, code, runtime and protocol hashes before access.
held_out.acceptance: Apply the frozen development advancement criteria on these eight held-out maps without adjustment.
held_out.claim_limit: Untouched by this live recovery tuning campaign; same-size seeded maps do not establish larger-map or general OpenTTD competence.

execution_gate: No tuning until correctness qualifications, committed executable study registration/driver/reporting, all-map control matching, held-out refusal tests and cost estimate pass. This protocol alone cannot authorize a model or open a held-out game.
